Product Features

  • Stylish and minimalist design is the highlight of this sideboard, white glossy doors make this sideboard simple and beautiful, the bottom of the LED light can make it very ambient in the evening!
  • A pair of doors that open and close, and a single door. Each of them has an adjustable shelf that can be adjusted in height to suit your various storage needs.
  • As a visual highlight, the doors have a high-gloss design and are illuminated by LED lights on the floor, which is nice without dazzling. The high-gloss panels give the sideboard a high-quality and modern look.
  • Practical sideboard with extra-large cabinet doors and doors that keep things tidy. With its minimalist design and simple, elegant shape, as well as the snow-white high-gloss finish of the doors and LED lighting, this LED sideboard is suitable for a variety of scenarios, such as a dining table or sideboard, and can be placed in the bedroom, dining room or living room.
  • The whole thing is well thought out and even the smallest details are well thought out. The surface is made of damage- and moisture-resistant chipboard. In addition, it does not fade or discolor under the influence of sunlight. And it is moisture-resistant, even if it can be placed in the bathroom.
  • EASY ASSEMBLY: There are two packages for this sideboard, please make sure you have received both packages and start assembling, our products come with easy to understand instructions, each part is labeled and pictured. You can install it easily and you don't have to panic about installation
  • The high gloss position of this credenza is on the front of the three sides of the cabinet door, and it is with the lamination process, after you have fully assembled, tear the lamination, you can play this high gloss credenza to the maximum visual effect!
  • This sideboard has a load capacity of 60 kg and more storage space than a regular sideboard. It has an anti-tilt design to ensure durability and safety.

Descriptions

Description

Sideboard and storage cabinet made of high-quality chipboard, LED light strip. Dimensions: 120*40*75 cm. The main color is white with high-gloss doors and the base is equipped with LED light strips. It can be controlled with the remote control, with 16 colors and 4 dynamic modes, and Bluetooth connectivity to switch more colors. The simple, minimalist design and the 60 kg load capacity are the highlights of this sideboard. The combination of high-gloss design and LED lights makes this sideboard even more environmentally friendly. The doors are equipped with rebound dampers that ensure that the doors close tightly, even if they are shaken violently.

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
